sentences.text: 1 Signing time: 15-Sep-23 6:31:00 PM  2  JUDGEMENT 1.

Present miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 is filed assailing the impugned award dated 15.10.2014 passed in Claim Case No. 32 of 2014 by Third Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Gwalior (M.P.).
2.

entities.text: Third Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As per case of claimant, he was going from Dabra to Bhitarwar with his friend Sobaran Singh on the Motorcycle.
He was siting on the back seat of the motorcycle.

Near Bijlighar respondent No.1 came driving the vehicle Mahindra Jeep bearing No. M.P.07/H-1423 in very rash and negligent manner from the opposite side and dashed his motorcycle due to which he sustained grievous injuries.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that learned claims tribunal has awarded the compensation on the lesser side and prayed that just and proper compensation be granted to the claimant.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company supported the quantum of compensation awarded by learned claims tribunal and prayed for rejection of this appeal.

5. Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the available record.
6.

Having gone through the evidence adduced by the both the parties before learned claims tribunal and considering the nature of the case, the compensation as awarded by learned claims tribunal is liable to be enhanced by Rs.75,000/- (Rs. Seventy Five Thousand Only) in lump sum which shall be payable to appellant - claimant in addition to already awarded amount by the claims tribunal i.e.

. 
7. The enhanced amount of Rs.75,000/- shall not carry any interest, however, if the insurance company fails to make the payment of compensation within a period of 12 weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order, then the enhanced amount of award shall carry interest at the rate of 6% per annum.
Rest of the conditions as imposed by learned claims tribunal shall remain intact.

8. If the enhanced amount of compensation is in excess to the valuation of appeal, the difference of the Court fee (if not already paid) shall be deposited by the appellant - claimant within four weeks'
from today and proof thereof shall be submitted before the Registry.
Thereafter, Registry shall issue the certified copy of the order passed today.
10. Appeal stand allowed to the aforesaid extent and disposed of.
